RegisterStatus.description_en:
The registration status. Valid values:

0: Registration failed. The reason may be that the qualification information is inconsistent with the MIIT registration information or the carrier does not support it. Log on to the Short Message Service console (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign) to view the specific reason and perform operations as prompted.
1: Registered and pending verification. At least one sub-port carrier has returned a successful registration. Send verification codes or notification messages to mobile phone numbers of different carriers in small batches and multiple times for verification.
2: Registration expired. The registration result expires if the signature has no sending records for more than 6 months. To reuse the signature, initiate registration again in the Short Message Service console (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign).
3: Registration successful. At least one sub-port carrier has returned a successful registration, and the verified message delivery success rate meets expectations. Continue to monitor the delivery success rate.
-1: Registering. No registration result has been received from the carrier. Wait until the signature registration status changes to Registered and pending verification before sending messages in batches. You can try sending messages by using this signature in small batches and multiple times to observe the delivery effect.
-2: Not registered. The reason may be that the signature is not associated with a real-name qualification or the associated qualification information is incomplete. Modify the current qualification or edit the signature to bind another qualification to initiate registration again.

For more information about signature real-name registration and recommended operations, see [Signature real-name registration details and recommended operations]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2873145.html）
RegisterStatus.description_zh:
报备状态。取值：

0：报备失败，原因可能为资质信息与工信注册信息不一致或运营商侧无法支持等。建议您登录短信服务控制台 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign)查看具体失败原因，并依据提示进行操作；
1：已报备待验证，当前至少有一个子端口号运营商已返回报备通过，建议您少量多次向不同运营商手机号发送验证码、通知短信进行验证；
2：报备失效，签名超过 6 个月无发送记录时，报备结果失效。如您需要重新启用该签名，请在短信服务控制台 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign)重新发起报备；
3：报备成功，当前至少有一个子端口号运营商已返回报备通过，经验证短信发送成功率符合预期，建议您持续关注发送成功率；
-1：报备中，当前尚未收到运营商反馈的报备结果，建议您等待签名报备状态变更为“已报备待验证”后再批量发送，当前可少量多次尝试使用该签名发送，观察短信发送效果；
-2：未报备，原因可能为当前签名未关联实名资质或关联资质信息不全，建议您修改当前资质或编辑签名绑定其他资质以重新发起报备。

建议您单击查看[更多签名实名制报备内容及建议操作]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2873145.html）

RegisterStatusReasons.description_en: The list of reasons for the registration status

ReasonCode.description_en:
The reason code for the registration status. Valid values:
UNBINDING_QUA: The signature is not associated with a qualification.
BINDING_INCOMPLETE_QUA: The associated qualification information is incomplete.
NON_REGISTER: Registration is not initiated.
REGISTERING: The signature is being registered.
DETECTING: Detection is not initiated or is in progress.
DETECT_SUCCESS: Registration is successful.
QUALIFICATION_ERROR: Qualification error.
SIGNATURE_ERROR: Signature error.
SIGNATURE_QUALIFICATION_ERROR: The signature and qualification do not match.
ONE_CODE_MULTIPLE_SIGN: Extension code error.
OTHERS_ERROR: Other errors.
REGISTER_TIMEOUT: Registration timed out.
NO_SEND_RECORD: The signature has no sending records for more than 6 months.
EXT_CODE_RECYCLE: The extension code is reclaimed.
SUBPORT_RECYCLE: The sub-port is regulated by the carrier
ReasonCode.description_zh:
报备状态原因码。取值：
UNBINDING_QUA：签名未关联资质；
BINDING_INCOMPLETE_QUA：关联资质信息不全；
NON_REGISTER：未发起报备；
REGISTERING：签名报备中；
DETECTING：未发起探测或探测中；
DETECT_SUCCESS：报备成功；
QUALIFICATION_ERROR：资质原因；
SIGNATURE_ERROR：签名原因；
SIGNATURE_QUALIFICATION_ERROR：签名与资质关系不符；
ONE_CODE_MULTIPLE_SIGN：扩展码原因；
OTHERS_ERROR：其他原因；
REGISTER_TIMEOUT：报备超时；
NO_SEND_RECORD：签名超过6个月无发送记录；
EXT_CODE_RECYCLE：扩展码收回。
SUBPORT_RECYCLE：子端口被运营商治理
